name: NIH Documents: Biosketch, Current and Pending, MFTRP
intro_text: Once a year, NIH needs current documents from the Center’s senior/key personnel for the yearly progress report (RPPR). Make your biosketch and your Current and Pending (Other) Support in SciENcv, using NIH’s Common Forms, and upload the certified PDFs here.

about: Each year NIH needs a current biosketch, Current and Pending (Other) Support, and MFTRP certification from the Center’s senior/key personnel.
They go into the Center’s yearly progress report (RPPR).

mftrp.label: Download your certification form (PDF, your name already filled in)

questions.prompt: Will there be, in the next budget period, either (1) a reduction of 25% or more in the level of effort from what was approved by the agency for the PD/PI(s) or other senior/key personnel designated in the Notice of Award, or (2) a reduction in the level of effort below the minimum amount of effort required by the Notice of Award?
questions.help_text: This is RPPR question D.2.a, word for word. In short: will your CNAP effort drop by 25% or more next budget year (starting June 1)? NIH treats a Yes as a request for prior approval. If the drop has already happened, tell the evaluator, because a separate request is needed.

questions.prompt: If Yes: describe the change, with your current and planned calendar months and when the change starts.

sections.title: Biosketch and Current and Pending (Other) Support
sections.instructions:
Make both in SciENcv (www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sciencv), using NIH’s Common Forms. Your biosketch PDF includes the NIH Biographical Sketch Supplement.
Certify each one yourself in SciENcv, then download the PDF. Don’t flatten it afterward: NIH checks the certification. Your ORCID iD must show in the Persistent Identifier (PID) section.

questions.prompt: Biosketch: Common Form with the NIH Supplement (certified PDF from SciENcv)
Current and Pending (Other) Support: Common Form (certified PDF from SciENcv)

sections.title: MFTRP certification
sections.instructions:
Every year, NIH requires each senior/key person to certify in the RPPR whether they are a party to a Malign Foreign Talent Recruitment Program (MFTRP).
Download the form below. Sign it with an Adobe digital signature, save it as a flattened PDF, as NIH asks, and upload it here.

sections.title: Foreign-activity documents (only if you have any)

questions.prompt: Supporting documentation: copies of contracts for foreign appointments, or for employment with a foreign institution (optional, one flattened PDF)
questions.help_text: NIH takes these as a separate attachment, not inside your Current and Pending. Leave this blank if you have none.

_source: MW 2026-10-27: PPLs, RPLs, core directors and the CNAP Director upload SciENcv biosketch and Current and Pending once a year; MFTRP certification and D.2.a in the same task; optional foreign-activity documents. Piestar thread (Apr 2026) for D.2 and MFTRP. SciENcv Common Forms required for RPPRs from Jan 25, 2026 (Stanford ORA notice). Wording per NOT-OD-26-018 (Common Forms; NIH Biosketch Supplement; don't flatten SciENcv PDFs; annual MFTRP certification in RPPR G.1 as a flattened PDF named MFTRPcert_[Name].pdf; supporting documentation as a separate flattened attachment) and NOT-OD-26-033 (enforced from May 8, 2026).
